mcpServers.title: FilmCraft
mcpServers.description: Connect to the local FilmCraft desktop app for visible project inspection, editing, and export.

interface.shortDescription: Edit speech, shorts, multicam, B-roll, audio, captions and graphics
interface.longDescription: Select FilmCraft and describe the result. The main English skill composes editorial workflows adapted from pinned ChatCut originals, executed through the visible local FilmCraft editor. Source snapshots, licenses, adaptation boundaries and a consolidated acceptance checklist are included. Specific editor features require live command capability; this package does not add avatar, cloning or lip-sync generation services. Existing Nexts production workflows remain available.
defaultPrompt: Clean this presenter recording, preserve meaning, add accurate subtitles and export it.
Make three complete short excerpts from this lecture with subtitles.
Reorder this interview by topic, synchronize the two cameras and cut to the speaker.
Add these B-roll clips, a quiet music bed and chapter titles without changing the speech.
Only translate the subtitles; preserve the existing cut and audio.
Export the current FilmCraft sequence and verify the actual output file.
